articles.summary: Welcome to week two of the OpenTofu workshop! This week, we'll dive into the concept of modular infrastructure using OpenTofu. Modules are a powerful way to organize your code, promote reusability, and enforce best practices in Infrastructure as Code (IaC). By the end of this session, you'll be able to create your own modules, use existing ones, and apply best practices for modular infrastructure design.
articles.title: OpenTofu Foundations: Building Composable Infrastructure-as-Code Modules (Part 2)

articles.summary: Welcome to week four of the OpenTofu Foundations workshop! This week, we'll dive into some of the advanced strategies for managing OpenTofu resources, including data sources, loops, conditionals, dynamic blocks, and lifecycle rules.
articles.title: OpenTofu Foundations: Advanced Resource Management (Part 4)

articles.summary: Learn how to incorporate testing and validation into your OpenTofu workflows. This session will focus on tools and practices for testing your infrastructure code, including syntax validation, resource policy checks, and simulating infrastructure changes before applying them.
articles.title: OpenTofu Foundations: Testing and Validation with OpenTofu (Part 6)

articles.summary: Welcome to week three of the OpenTofu workshop This week, we'll dive into functions and control structures. 90% of what we do as programmers is validate unknown data being passed to our programs, and manipulating imperfect data so we can connect software modules together. Functions help us provide a better more intuitive user experience and keep our code clean.
articles.title: OpenTofu Foundations: Functions and Control Structures (Part 3)

articles.summary: OpenTofu is an infrastructure-as-code tool that lets you define both cloud and on-prem resources in human-readable configuration files that you can version, reuse, and share. This post will help you get started using OpenTofu to manage your Azure resources.
articles.title: Getting Started with OpenTofu on Azure

articles.summary: Integrate OpenTofu into CI/CD pipelines to automate infrastructure deployments. Set up a pipeline to test, validate, and apply configurations reliably.
articles.title: OpenTofu Foundations: Integrating OpenTofu into CI/CD Pipelines (Part 5)

articles.summary: As platform engineers, DevOps professionals, and operations experts, our primary role is to empower developers—to make them more efficient, to help them ship faster and more confidently.
articles.title: Are We Approaching Infrastructure as Code the Wrong Way?

articles.summary: Learn how to implement Convention over Configuration principles in your Infrastructure as Code using OpenTofu, making your IaC more maintainable and developer-friendly.
articles.title: Convention over Configuration: Building Developer-Friendly IaC with OpenTofu
